hindi: बारिश के बाद मिट्टी से आने वाली सोंधी खुशबू
definition: the pleasant, earthy smell after rain falls on dry ground
example: She breathed in the petrichor after the first monsoon shower.

hindi: यह एहसास कि हर अजनबी का जीवन उतना ही जटिल है जितना आपका
definition: the realization that each passerby is living a life as vivid and complex as your own
example: Waiting at the station, a wave of sonder washed over him.

definition: the occurrence of happy or beneficial events by chance
example: Meeting her old mentor there was pure serendipity.

hindi: किसी को खिड़की से बाहर फेंकने की क्रिया
definition: the act of throwing someone or something out of a window
example: The history lesson turned oddly gripping at the defenestration of Prague.

hindi: गूंजदार, गहरी और मधुर ध्वनि वाला
definition: capable of producing a deep or full sound; rich and resonant
example: The bell's sonorous chime filled the valley.

definition: lasting for a very short time
example: Fame can be surprisingly ephemeral.

definition: a whispering, murmuring, or rustling sound
example: A susurrus of leaves followed the evening breeze.

hindi: किसी के प्रति गहन प्रेमासक्ति की मनोदशा, प्रतिदान की तीव्र चाह के साथ
definition: the state of being infatuated, with an intense longing for reciprocation
example: The early weeks of the romance were pure limerence.

definition: sweet or musical; pleasant to hear
example: Her mellifluous voice soothed the restless crowd.

definition: extremely idealistic and unrealistic; impractical
example: His quixotic plan to end all traffic was doomed.

hindi: पुरानी किताबों की दुकानों की उदासी भरी खुशबू
definition: the strange wistfulness of old bookstores
example: A quiet vellichor hung among the dusty second-hand shelves.

hindi: शांत, सुखमय और समृद्ध (बीता हुआ समय)
definition: denoting a period in the past that was idyllically happy and peaceful
example: She recalled the halcyon days of her childhood summers.

definition: wicked or criminal
example: The detective uncovered their nefarious scheme.

definition: light, thin, and delicate
example: The dress was made of gossamer silk.

hindi: अवर्णनीय, शब्दों में न व्यक्त होने वाला
definition: too great or extreme to be expressed in words
example: She felt an ineffable joy at the summit.

definition: fluent, forceful, and persuasive expression
example: He spoke with an eloquence that silenced the hall.

definition: resembling a maze; intricate and confusing
example: The tax rules are famously labyrinthine.

definition: the state of being alone, often by choice and peacefully
example: He sought solitude in the mountains to write.

definition: kept secret or done secretively, especially because illicit
example: They held clandestine meetings after dark.

definition: having or showing a feeling of vague or regretful longing
example: She gave a wistful smile at the old photograph.
